name: A King's Tribute
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
So our good King would like a memorial built in honor of a soldier named Sully Balloo?  And you say the poor chap died during the Thandol Span tragedy?

Bah, will there ever be peace on Azeroth?

Nonetheless, any commission from the King is of utmost importance. To build a truly epic and lasting piece I want to work with one of the finest stones available. Travel to Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad and gather for me some Alterac Granite.
narrative.objectives: Grand Mason Marblesten of Ironforge wants 5 pieces of Alterac Granite.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Perfect! Better than I could have imagined!

And I have quite an imagination you know...
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer, adventurer, adventurer! Tell me you have enough Alterac Granite for me to begin my masterpiece in honor of Sully Balloo.
